## Your AppToken

This method can be used to verify your current access token _(the AppToken)_.

The response includes the de-serialized version of the token passed in the request header.

> ❗️ 403
>
> The server replies with a 403 if the token is invalid or no longer valid.


#### Response

```json Response example
{
    "id": "06ffa802-06a7-4350-9f3f-46a4e577575b",
    "applicationId": "af4fd972-7b87-48a5-bdeb-dd3546cf268a",
    "token": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.e30.Et9HFtf9R3GEMA0IICOfFMVXY7kkTX1wr4qCyhIf58U",
    "bundle": {
        "resources": [
            "organisation.67465728-e0b0-4169-bd4b-ccf67727ba5b",
            "store.a4e5becb-afa6-4db7-b1d4-e8db389e6794"
        ],
        "permissions": {
            "organisation.*.*": true,
            "store.*.*": true,
            "pos.*.*": true
        },
        "userId": "36806adc-d16c-49c6-ab59-72c4cbdff4c4",
        "isSubToken": true
    }
}
```
